race.comment: Competitive sprint with some real talents. BRIDAL WALTZ (9) resumes. She was a very good winner with 60kg over 1000m last time in. The runner up Midwest is a speedy horse and she was too strong, close up in a pair of G1's after that. Love the set up for her here at 1100m, she can stalk the speed and have last say. WAR MACHINE (1) was scratched after breaking through the barriers at Flemington and has since had an enforced jumpout. He didn't come up last campaign but did smash BRIDAL WALTZ in a G2 Gilgai and is very well in considering he's a G1 winner. The new kid on the block is OLIVEANOTHERDAY (3) who has won 5/7 and went through the grades very well over the Autumn/Winter. Won the Wangoom at Warrnambool dominantly, this is tougher but there are high aspirations for him. INKARUNA (8) has ability and can run well fresh from DON'T HOPE DO (7) who will be up on speed.
